objective_value: <float> Total portfolio cost combining the regularization penalty, the value-at-risk threshold, and the conditional value-at-risk contribution.
x: <list[float], length N> Fraction of total wealth allocated to each asset.
z: <list[int], length N> Whether each asset is selected for inclusion in the portfolio (1 = included, 0 = excluded).
a: <float> Value-at-risk threshold representing the loss level below which tail losses are measured.
v: <float> Conditional value-at-risk contribution capturing the expected severity of losses beyond the value-at-risk threshold.
